description: A bed with a blue blanket and a pale pillow is in front, and two small white drawer-like pieces sit on the blanket near the right side. The right hand grips one drawer piece and slides it leftward and slightly upward to align it with the other, while the left hand reaches in from the left to steady the upper piece; together the hands stack and press the parts into place, then the right hand relaxes its grip as the assembled unit sits upright.
